sections.title: I-CAR Component Library
body: Use this page as a content-driven inventory of the major section families used across the I-CAR marketing and information page system.
The legacy HTML reference remains available under html/documentation/component-library.html, while this page gives us a cleaner JSON-backed catalog that can be rebuilt into CMS-ready output.

sections.title: Hero Patterns
body: The hero family covers the top-of-page layouts most often used for landing pages, information hubs, and section intros.
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3 pt-3 mt-3

cards.title: Overview Hero
cards.body: A headline-first hero with label, sublabel, fuller intro copy, CTA, and linked banner image.

cards.title: 50/50 Hero
cards.body: Balanced text and media layout with strong flexibility for campaign and landing page intros.

cards.title: 40/60 Hero
cards.body: Compact content column paired with a larger visual treatment for media-led pages.

cards.title: 60/40 Hero
cards.body: Wider content column for denser messaging while still preserving a supporting visual.

sections.title: Text / Media Patterns
body: These patterns combine editorial content with imagery, sliders, or supporting media blocks.
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4 pt-3 mt-3

cards.title: 50/50 Text / Media
cards.body: Classic side-by-side layout for explanatory content and supporting visual context.

cards.title: 40/60 Text / Media
cards.body: Content-forward layout with additional room for image-led or slider-based storytelling.

cards.title: 60/40 Text / Media
cards.body: Useful when the copy needs extra depth but the section still benefits from a supporting image.

sections.title: Centered Patterns
body: Centered sections are best for single-message storytelling, quotes, short editorials, and table-based reference content.
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4 pt-3 mt-3

cards.title: Centered Editorial
cards.body: Headline, supporting copy, and optional subhead in a centered editorial presentation.

cards.title: Centered Media
cards.body: Centered intro copy paired with a single supporting image or media block.

cards.title: Centered Table
cards.body: Reference-style section for presenting structured comparisons or information tables.

cards.title: Centered Long Quote
cards.body: Expanded quote treatment for prominent testimonials or mission-forward statements.

cards.title: Centered Short Quote
cards.body: More compact quote pattern for tighter page pacing and shorter testimonials.

sections.title: Content Rail Patterns
body: Rail layouts pair a sticky intro area with supporting cards, lists, accordions, or timelines.
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4 pt-3 mt-3

cards.title: List Rail
cards.body: Sticky section intro with stacked content cards or list-driven resource blocks.

cards.title: Content Rail
cards.body: General-purpose rail for grouped requirements, standards, or multi-card informational sections.

cards.title: Media Rail
cards.body: Rail intro with supporting media assets and adjacent supporting copy.

cards.title: Accordion Rail
cards.body: Sticky intro plus FAQ or expandable reference content using accordion behavior.

cards.title: Timeline Rail
cards.body: Chronological milestone presentation with a left-hand intro and stacked milestone cards.

sections.title: Card Grid Patterns
body: Grid layouts cover the largest variety of repeatable content: image grids, icon grids, logos, quotes, profiles, and compact feature cards.
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4 pt-3 mt-3

cards.title: Standard Image Grid
cards.body: Multi-card image grid for initiatives, programs, and featured content collections.

cards.title: Card Image Grid
cards.body: Slider-style or card-based course/resource grids with strong thumbnail support.

cards.title: Stacked Image Grid
cards.body: Tall stacked cards that combine imagery with more editorial-style copy.

cards.title: Compact Card Icon Grid
cards.body: Dense icon-driven benefit or feature grids for overviews and value props.

cards.title: Icon Grid and Card Icon Grid
cards.body: Icon-led patterns for training formats, tools, features, and grouped directional content.

cards.title: Quote, Logo, and Profile Grids
cards.body: Repeatable collections for testimonials, partner trust marks, and leadership headshots.

sections.title: Reference Resources
body: Use this documentation page for the high-level pattern inventory, then use the template demo and existing content pages for concrete JSON authoring examples.
